claim: In the two Blood towns measured, streets run a median 7,168 (E3M1) and 7,552 (DWE3M1) units wide, about 19 player widths, against 5,120-5,248 in all four DukCity maps; E3M1's facade height is a median 1.68 times its street width, DukCity's 2.1, DWE3M1's only 0.32 (a low town). DukCity's alleys are about 1,024 and its plazas 8k-24k.
